title: An ensemble-based machine learning model for predicting type 2 diabetes and its effect on bone health
summary: Ensemble XGBoost and random-forest models using DXA and clinical data from 206 Qatar Biobank participants predicted type 2 diabetes with up to 87.2% accuracy. Feature ablation and SHAP analysis described bone-health patterns associated with the predictions; the retrospective case-control study does not establish causation or clinical benefit.
ai_technology: Ensemble XGBoost/RF models use 206 Qatar Biobank DXA and clinical features, with RFE and SHAP explainability.

evidence.tested: The case checks report up to 87.2% accuracy for type 2 diabetes prediction in a 206-participant Qatar Biobank cohort and describe feature patterns associated with bone health. Held-out model evaluation and feature ablation support this bounded retrospective result; no clinical-benefit claim is established.
evidence.unknown: The result is limited to the reported dataset, experimental setting and validation in this study; broader generalization and real-world benefit are not established.
